A lot of these answers are based on how you emotionally feel about your SO and that is obviously important. You really should also consider the financial aspect of moving in with someone. Does your SO have a steady job? Do they have any habits that would impact whether they could make the rent and expenses each month? Do they have major credit card debt that could signify a spending problem? Have you discussed how the bills will be shared? Who's name will be on the lease? Will you be buying renters insurance? I could go on but you really need to think through these things before moving in with someone otherwise you could be setting yourself up for a major credit or financial issue. Of course, there's a lot more involved with living with someone that could make or break the relationship but financial issues can follow you for a long time if things don't work out.

Find out how they deal with previous breakups and relationships. If they have a history of throwing items out the window or driving cars into front doors, or just got released from prison for murdering their Ex, you should probably wait.
